connection.TGlua2VkSW5SZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source:
A connection to the [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com) Pages Data Portability API product, which gives a LinkedIn Page administrator access to the organization's posts, comments, reactions, followers and page analytics.

Requires OAuth2 credentials (`oauth2_client_id` and `oauth2_client_secret`) from a [LinkedIn developer application](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) that has been **approved for the Pages Data Portability API product** — a separate LinkedIn approval that grants the `r_dma_admin_pages_content` permission and takes several business days. The connection uses the `linkedindma://` URL scheme
connection.TGlua2VkSW5SZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message:
連接到 [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com) Pages Data Portability API 產品，讓 LinkedIn 專頁管理員可存取組織的貼文、留言、反應、追蹤者與專頁分析資料。

需要從 [LinkedIn 開發者應用程式](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) 取得 OAuth2 憑證 (`oauth2_client_id` 和 `oauth2_client_secret`)，且該應用程式必須已通過 **Pages Data Portability API 產品** 的審核 —— 這是一項獨立的 LinkedIn 審核，會授予 `r_dma_admin_pages_content` 權限，並需數個工作天。此連接使用 `linkedindma://` URL 方案

connection.TGlua2VkSW5SZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source:
The LinkedIn API version in `YYYYMM` form, sent in the `LinkedIn-Version` header with every versioned request.  LinkedIn never defaults to the latest version: a missing or sunset version is an error, and each version is supported for a limited time, so this must be moved forward periodically.

Note that LinkedIn's Marketing APIs and its Pages Data Portability (DMA) APIs have **separate** version series; a value from one series is not valid in the other.
connection.TGlua2VkSW5SZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message:
以 `YYYYMM` 格式傳送的 LinkedIn API 版本，於每個版本請求中包含在 `LinkedIn-Version` 標頭內。LinkedIn 永遠不會預設使用最新版本：缺少或已停用的版本會導致錯誤，且每個版本僅支援有限時間，因此必須定期更新。

注意，LinkedIn 的行銷 API 與其 Pages Data Portability (DMA) API 擁有 **獨立** 的版本系列；一個系列的值無法在另一系列中使用

connection.TGlua2VkSW5SZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source:
A connection to the [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com) REST API for posting and managing content as the authenticated member.

Requires OAuth2 credentials (`oauth2_client_id` and `oauth2_client_secret`) from a [LinkedIn developer application](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) with the **Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect** and **Share on LinkedIn** products enabled. The connection uses the `linkedin://` URL scheme
connection.TGlua2VkSW5SZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message:
與 [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com) REST API 的連接，用於以已驗證成員身分發佈和管理內容。

需要從 [LinkedIn 開發者應用程式](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) 取得 OAuth2 憑證 (`oauth2_client_id` 和 `oauth2_client_secret`)，並啟用 **使用 OpenID Connect 登入 LinkedIn** 和 **分享至 LinkedIn** 功能。此連接使用 `linkedin://` URL 方案
